analyst_view.overall: Early view: with a month to go, Freiburg (14th, six points) host Panathinaikos (2nd, nine points) on matchday 5. Freiburg have won four in a row, including at Trabzonspor, and are third in the Bundesliga on Sky Sports' table; Panathinaikos lead the Greek league with four goals conceded in nine games. The site makes Freiburg favourites, but Panathinaikos have the better European record.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.7 goals. Panathinaikos's tight defence argues down, while their 5-1 win at Kairat and Freiburg's 3-2 against Jablonec show both can be in open games. I stay with the number.
